description: Supplier selection record emitted by the yoro-supply supplier_selection Pregel cell. Captures the chosen supplier for one BOM line item, the RFQ response CID (G2 IPFS-pinned), and the Charter Rider §2(g) conflict-minerals + rare-earth-free attestation (G5). One record per BOM line × selected supplier. Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G1 (QC firmware open-source), G2, G5 (Charter Rider §2(g)).

selectionId.description: Stable identifier for this (BOM-line × supplier) selection.

projectBomLineRef.description: Opaque reference to a line in the parent projectBOM. The BOM itself lives in tatekata's project scope; this lexicon just cites the line.

materialClass.description: Material class. R1 ships concrete/steel/lumber/drywall/paint; R2+ expands to 20+ suppliers across all classes.

supplierReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-recognized supplier identifier (DID or registered company ID). Free-text company names disallowed.

supplierJurisdictionCode.description: Optional ISO-3166-2 + municipality suffix; R1 targets Japan (`JP-*`) + United States (`US-*`).

rfqResponseIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the RFQ response document (price quote + lead time + spec compliance).

quotedUnitPriceMicroCents.description: Quoted unit price in micro-cents (USD × 10^4 if cents, × 10^6 if dollars). Per ADR-2605190900 — no float types for money. Currency context held by `quotedCurrencyCode`.

conflictMineralAuditCid.description: G5: IPFS CID of the supplier's conflict-minerals audit (Charter Rider §2(g) — no tantalum/tin/tungsten/gold from DRC conflict zones; no Xinjiang-sourced minerals; no rare-earth from PRC monopoly chains without third-party audit).

rareEarthFreeAttested.description: G5: TRUE if the material contains zero rare-earth elements; FALSE if rare-earth content is present but third-party-audited (see conflictMineralAuditCid).

qcFirmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the supplier's QC testing equipment firmware manifest (open-source verification).
